explanation: This fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a1 that made the rare move to S2 and got no reward: then it is usually 9-10, though it sometimes drops to about 3-8, more often later in the episode. Every other step is 0, including every GO and D2 step, every D1 after a rewarded trial, after an unrewarded common a1 to S1 trial, or after any a2 trial.
